answer: The master keeps two books: one for the work done, one for the men who did it, and the two must agree to the last line. Draper cloth measure with drapers attestation is the second book, the one that names the men: eight-year measure, 12,000 yards measured, wool accounts, annual inspection. Enter a false prism and both books are opened, the cheat pays the wages of a full season twice over and the cedar is struck from the roll, while the tundra is preserved and read when the dispute is heard.
